units.source_text: 至今我已见过舞女这一行人两次。

en.t: By now I had seen the dancer and her group twice.

units.source_text: 初次是在我到汤岛来的途中，她们正去修善寺，

en.t: The first time was on my way to Yushima, when they were heading for Shuzenji,

units.source_text: 是在汤川桥附近遇见的。

en.t: and I met them near Yukawa Bridge.

units.source_text: 当时有三个年轻的姑娘。

en.t: At that time there were three young girls.
The dancer was carrying a drum.

units.source_text: 我不时回头看看她们，一股旅行的情趣油然而生。

en.t: I kept looking back at them from time to time, and a feeling of travel stirred naturally within me.

units.source_text: 然后是翌日晚上在汤岛，她们来到旅馆演出。

en.t: Then, the next evening in Yushima, they came to the inn to perform.

units.source_text: 我坐在楼梯中央，聚精会神地观赏着那位舞女在门厅里跳舞。

en.t: I sat halfway up the stairs and watched intently as the dancer danced in the entrance hall.
